articles.title: Washington State DFI Enters Consent Order with Mortgage Servicer Newrez LLC
articles.summary: Olympia – The Washington State Department of Financial Institutions (DFI) entered a Consent Order with Newrez LLC (Newrez), a large non-bank mortgage servicer that operates nationwide. The Consent Order resolves WA DFI’s Statement of Charges (Charges) issued in March 2026.DFI’s Charges followed an in-depth investigation of more than 125 consumer complaints.
